baseline_inspected: GitHub main was 1.13.0 build 1923 before this package.

root_causes.five_minute_runtime: 1923 performed many specific POI lookups individually with concurrency 3. Each item could serially try multiple Nominatim queries and multiple Overpass radii/endpoints. It also searched accommodation in place-provider and then app.js discarded those accommodation results before running overnight-accommodation again.
root_causes.accommodation_false_negative: 1923 overnight accommodation only trusted a narrow set of OSM tourism tags. Real accommodation can exist without those exact tags. Ulbeek is a concrete example: public web results show actual accommodation there, so an empty structured OSM result must not be presented as 'there is no accommodation'.
root_causes.pending_images_too_fast: app.js changes the pending image every 1 second.

changes.poi_pipeline: Specific non-accommodation POIs are now resolved with one batched Overpass query per travel day instead of one multi-provider chain per individual POI.
changes.single_accommodation_authority: place-provider no longer performs the accommodation search that app.js immediately discards. overnight-accommodation is the only accommodation resolver.
changes.accommodation_pipeline: All overnight points are searched together: 25 km batched Overpass first, then one 60 km batch only for unresolved nights, then Photon and Nominatim fallbacks.
changes.no_blank_accommodation: If all structured sources fail, each night gets an actionable live Google Maps search link instead of a false 'no accommodation' conclusion.
changes.pending_images: Visible pending image changes are throttled to 4 seconds, within the requested 3–5 second interval.
changes.generated_stop_speed: Generated-stop land validation now races Nominatim and Photon reverse lookup and processes up to 3 stops concurrently; the old 32-point serial ring scan is removed.
